title: Bluehost Review 2026: Pricing, Renewals and WordPress Plans

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Bluehost Review 2026: Pricing, Renewals and WordPress Plans
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Bluehost review for 2026: plan prices, the renewal jump, WordPress hosting, support and who it suits, with a short guide to setting up your first site.
meta.rl_answer: Bluehost is an easy host for a first WordPress site. Starter was $3.99 a month on a 36-month term and renews at $11.49. Phone support starts on Business.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Bluehost a good hosting company? | Yes for beginners building a first WordPress site. TechRadar calls it one of the easiest recommendations, with guided setup and a clear panel. The trade-offs are the renewal price and speed that trails LiteSpeed hosts.
Is Bluehost a good web host? | Yes for small and medium sites with a US audience. WPBeginner measured 100% uptime over 30 days and 933 ms Largest Contentful Paint. Visitors in Asia see slower first responses.
How much does Bluehost cost? | On Bluehost's pricing page on 20 November 2026, Starter was $3.99 a month on a 36-month term, Business $3.49 and eCommerce Essentials $14.99. The 12-month offer was $4.24, $6.79 and $15.99. The full term is charged up front.
Is Bluehost overpriced at renewal? | The renewal is higher than the first price on every plan. Starter renews at $11.49 a month on a 36-month renewal, 2.9 times the $3.99 first price. WebHostPicks found a month-by-month renewal costs more than a long one.
How many websites can I host on Bluehost? | Starter allows 10 websites, Business 50 and eCommerce Essentials 100. Bluehost says its visit figures of 40,000, 200,000 and 400,000 a month are estimates for the right plan, not limits you can count on.
Why does Bluehost have negative reviews? | The common complaints are the high renewal price, extras added at checkout and speed behind LiteSpeed hosts. Bluehost itself shows a Trustpilot score of 4.4 from 32,360 reviews. Read the cart and the renewal price before you pay.
Is Bluehost recommended by WordPress.org? | Bluehost says it is recommended by WordPress.org, and its pages carry that statement. TechRadar also calls it one of the easiest hosts for a first WordPress site.
Does Bluehost have a money-back guarantee? | Yes. You can cancel within 30 days for a refund of the hosting. The guarantee does not cover most add-ons, and Bluehost deducts the domain fee if your plan included a free domain.
Is the Bluehost domain free? | The domain is free for the first year. After that it renews at the then current rate. Check the renewal price of your domain ending before you register it.
Does Bluehost have phone support? | Yes on Business and eCommerce Essentials. Starter includes chat only. Chat is available 24/7 on all plans.
Is Bluehost better than Hostinger? | On speed and price, Hostinger was ahead in WPBeginner's July 2026 tests: 659 ms against 933 ms. Bluehost offers phone support on higher plans and a guided path for a first WordPress site.
Is Bluehost fast enough for my site? | For most small sites, yes. Independent tests measured 0.69 s to 0.90 s Largest Contentful Paint in the US. TechRadar saw response times rise under 15 users on a store, so heavier sites may need a bigger plan.
Does Bluehost include email? | Professional Email starts as a one-month free trial. It then renews at $2.99 a month, according to Bluehost's pricing page.
Can I move my site to Bluehost? | TechRadar lists migration as included on all three shared plans. Check Bluehost's migration terms before you start.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Starter was $3.99 a month on a 36-month term and renews at $11.49 (Bluehost, 20 Nov 2026).
The 12-month Black Friday offer was $4.24 and renews at $13.79. It ends 30 Nov 2026.
WPBeginner measured 933 ms Largest Contentful Paint against 659 ms for Hostinger.
Phone support starts on Business. Starter has chat only.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Bluehost is one of the easiest starting points for a first WordPress site. Pick the term carefully, read the renewal price, and use the 30-day window to test it. Look elsewhere if speed is your top priority or your visitors are outside the United States.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You are building your first WordPress site and want guidance.
Your visitors are mostly in the United States.
You want phone support on a higher plan.
meta.rl_r_skip:
Speed is your top priority: Hostinger was faster in WPBeginner's tests.
Your visitors are mostly in Asia or Europe.
You want daily backups on a budget plan.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Guided setup that suits a first WordPress site.
Recommended by WordPress.org, according to Bluehost.
Staging, SSH, WP-CLI and a firewall on every plan.
99.99% uptime guarantee and a 30-day money-back guarantee.
Phone support on Business and above.
meta.rl_r_cons:
Lowest prices need a 36-month term paid up front.
Renewal is 1.7 to 4.6 times the first price.
Weekly backups only on shared plans.
Slower than LiteSpeed hosts in WPBeginner's tests.
The domain fee is deducted from a refund.

meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our own site on Bluehost, so this is a research-based review. We did not run our own tests
Pricing and plan limits | Bluehost's pricing page and shared hosting page, read on 20 November 2026. We recorded each plan price, the term it needs, the renewal price, the limits and the guarantee
Independent tests | WPBeginner (July 2026), SimonHosting (May 2026), TechRadar (updated 19 October 2026) and Softwarestackpro with the Themeisle tracker (October 2026)
Competitor reviews | The top-ranking Bluehost reviews read for structure and questions: TechRadar, WebHostPicks, HostingConnector, AnalyzeBench, Top5India and Websiteplanet
Questions people ask | The questions the top pages answer in their headings, plus the questions people search for in Semrush, such as why Bluehost has negative reviews and how many sites you can host
When sources disagree | We show both numbers and say which we used. For prices we used Bluehost's own pages, because they are what you pay
Our calculations | The five-year cost table is our own arithmetic from Bluehost's 36-month prices and renewal rates
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live, and the page carries the date they were checked
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test, and we did not open a checkout cart. Each test number is credited to the team that measured it

meta.rl_r_final: Bluehost gives a first WordPress site a guided start and phone support on higher plans. Choose the term carefully, put the renewal price in your budget, and use the 30-day refund if it does not fit.
